## Testing Instructions

```bash
# Example:
mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8000
# Visit http://127.0.0.1:8000/PR/phpVar1 to verify
```

## Pre-Submission Checklist

- [ ] Follows `docs/.template.md` structure (for new documentation)
- [ ] PHP version indicators added/updated (Last Updated, Minimum PHP Version, Status)
- [ ] `mkdocs build --clean` passes with **no warnings**
- [ ] `npx playwright test` passes (all tests succeed)
- [ ] Internal links verified and working
- [ ] Related topics cross-linked appropriately
- [ ] Code examples use modern PHP 8.x syntax
- [ ] SQL examples use prepared statements
- [ ] External links use HTTPS
- [ ] Navigation (`mkdocs.yml`) updated if files added/renamed
- [ ] Commit message includes co-author trailer
- [ ] No deprecated functions in examples
